content:
I have generated using GPT-4 on azure (thanks to Microsoft and its AFMR program) descriptions of theorems in Mathlib and its dependencies (including Lean core and Std). My main motivation is for searching for related/relevant theorems in AI, but these may also be useful to human readers. Some descriptions are wrong but most seem reasonable (part of my reason for sharing is to get feedback)

The descriptions are all linked from a Basic website. An example module is Mathlib.Data.Prime. I have also shared the source.

As mentioned, the above is a crude site for sharing what I have. It can be incorporated in documentation after improvements if it seems useful.
